## Dependencies & Execution Order

```text
T001 → T002 → T003
                 ↓
(T004 → T005) + (T006 → T007) → T008  [foundation / S0 feasibility]
                 ↓
US1: (T009 || T010) → T011 → T012 → T013 → T014 → T015 → T016
                 ↓
US2: (T017 || T018) → T019 → T020 → T021 → T022 → T023
US3: T024 → T025 → T026 → T027 → T028 → T029 → T030
US4: (T031 || T032) → T033 → T034 → T035 → T036 → T037
                 ↓
T038 → T039 → T040 → T041 → T042
```

- Phase 1 precedes foundation. T004/T006 can be authored in parallel; T005/T007 then touch separate files. T008 is their joint build/integration checkpoint.
- US1 is the common temporal-composition base. US2's complete tests integrate against US1; US3's independent frozen-data/generator work (T024–T027) can start after foundation, while T028–T030 integrate against US1. US4 integrates against US1 and uses US2/US3 for the complete matrix.
- Default execution is sequential story order to avoid shared edits in read_om_series.cpp, series_plan.cpp and validation scripts. Do not execute US2/US3/US4 integration tasks concurrently on those files. Test authoring can overlap where paths differ.
- Within US1, T009 and T010 are independent authored checks. Within US2, T017 and T018 have separate files and common completed prerequisites. Within US3, provenance/generation/lookup is intentionally sequential; after T026, C++ lookup authoring in T027 can overlap preparation of model SQL cases from T029, but execute T029 only after T028. Within US4, T031 and T032 touch separate files.
- T038 can be drafted once contracts are stable while validation runs, with a single owner for quickstart.md; final documentation reconciliation precedes T041. T039–T042 require every story's integrated source, not intermediate outputs.
- Run a test/gate only when its required implementation/runtime/fixtures exist. A missing dependency is blocked, not a passing test. New integration changes invalidate affected earlier evidence and require the targeted re-run.

## Implementation Strategy

1. Start the later session by preserving the actual dirty baseline and checking binder/API reuse. Do not treat 008 completion or new infrastructure as a prerequisite to editing this feature's isolated units.
2. Deliver US1 with explicit time parameters and manual union equality as the smallest technical MVP. Finish US2 before declaring the P1 feature usable under the requested default absence policy.
3. Add frozen registered defaults through US3, keeping explicit overrides and spatial declarations independent. Prove inherited behavior and metrics via US4; fix only temporal-composition regressions.
4. Run final pinned-pair/controlled/real checks and update user guidance. Document scope limits and actual blocked gates. No deployment, Community publication or cross-architecture acceptance is part of these tasks.
